text: Object to any experiment here. Fear/panic are intensity 3 and the BeatSequenceValidator ceiling is 2 for every band; SafetyVocabulary documents that this ceiling keeps fear out of every band, and parents chose 'Sakin' or 'Biraz heyecan' on that promise. The source peaks at intensity 4, one book, HYPOTHESIS confidence. Running it as an A/B arm would mean deliberately exposing some children, possibly at bedtime, to frightening pages to measure completion, which completion/reread data cannot even evaluate (abandonment is not a fear signal). If ever revisited it needs child-development expert review, a new explicit parent-facing ContentSafety level, opt-in, and bedtime excluded, not an experiment.
